findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domainaudit_headers, domainaudit_seo, hn_hackernews, guard_check, webtools_email_validate, x402check_check · Private data: chainread_resolve, chainread_token, ciaudit_dockerfile, ciaudit_compose, ciaudit_github_actions, domainaudit_email, domainaudit_domain_info, edgar_filings, prices_token_price, tokenrisk_check, tokenrisk_verdict, webtools_email_validate · Public sink: chainread_resolve, domainaudit_email, domainaudit_audit, domainaudit_audit_bundle, edgar_facts_query, perps_oi, tokenrisk_check, webtools_email_validate · Destructive: ciaudit_github_actions.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
